headline: Haplotype-resolved references reshape expression, association and pedigree inference
label: Pangenome And Haplotype Resolution
summary: Three preprints from 19–20 November 2026 apply haplotype-resolved and graph-pangenome references to RNA-seq, GWAS and pedigree haplotype reconstruction.
synthesis: The shared thread is the replacement of a single linear reference with haplotype-resolved or graph-based representations, and the propagation of that choice into downstream inference. A parent-of-origin-resolved Granny Smith genome shows that matched references change RNA-seq differential expression and the biological conclusions drawn from it. A graph-pangenome workflow in Capsicum uses k-mer GWAS to localize hits and link capsaicinoid and aroma traits to haplotypes and candidate loci. PolyOrigin2 addresses the upstream step, reconstructing haplotypes in multi-generational diploid and tetraploid pedigrees with Bayesian phasing and GBS error models. The new element is the integration of haplotype-aware representation across reference construction, association testing and expression analysis, although the three items occupy different stages of this pipeline rather than reporting the same analysis.
